pages.text: SYN Finance Weekly, 2025-05-23. Money market fund returns are taxed at 15 percent withholding tax. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Investors should keep the tax certificates provided by their broker, bank or fund manager.

Investment income is taxed at source in most cases, so investors often receive the amount after tax. The figures above were correct at the time of publication and may change in future. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
